purpose: Machine-readable mandatory gate that makes every device/chat discover shared character-image rules, current work order, and failure knowledge before image work.
rules: Do not start character image work until the latest-main entrypoint, master rules, decision policy, current work order and failure knowledge have been read.
Apply every ACTIVE failure rule whose appliesTo matches the planned image/edit.
Derive the editing method from primary/secondary motion and completed donors; do not begin by assuming mesh or another technique.
Visually inspect a completed donor on the fixed drum before materially warping it.
Run AI visual QA after every meaningful donor composite, mesh, local transform, or AI local edit.
Numeric PASS never overrides visual FAIL.
If detector output conflicts with a visually completed donor, verify the detector before rejecting the donor.
Check recent main commits for work from other devices and do not regenerate newer approved/formal work.
Do not accept another device's PASS/FAIL blindly; reconcile inspected bytes, SHA/path, composite evidence and transaction.
After an image visual FAIL, add reusable image-production lessons to CHARACTER_FAILURE_KNOWLEDGE.json before the next retry.
Do not put runtime, Pages, chart, or general CI failures in the image failure ledger.
failClosed: If mandatory latest-main image rules/current work order/failure ledger cannot be read, do not generate/edit/promote a character image; other non-image work may continue.
discovery: AI_IMAGE_WORK_ENTRYPOINT.md is the single human/AI discovery point; README.md and CHARACTER_ASSET_PIPELINE.md point to it.
